# Procedure Step

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ProcedureStep`](gmeow-ProcedureStep.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ProcedureStep>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/procedures`](../../slices/procedures.md)

An atomic step within a [`Procedure`](gmeow-Procedure.md). Carries inputs, outputs, and parameters. May itself reference a subprocess [`Procedure`](gmeow-Procedure.md) via [`gmeow:stepEnactsProcedure`](../properties/gmeow-stepEnactsProcedure.md). The kind of step is a [`gmeow:StepType`](gmeow-StepType.md) value, never a subclass.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ProcedureStep`](gmeow-ProcedureStep.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
